About TAQA

 

Taqa Industrial and Petroleum Services Ltd is a company founded in 2011 with offices in Baghdad, Kirkuk, Basra and Amman.

TAQA is focused on introducing and developing global industrial technology and service to all regions of Iraq. To meet the growing needs of the local and regional market, we build and develop relationships with leading international industrial technology and engineering services partners.

Through years of experience of TAQA's founders serving a wide spectrum of industries including oil & gas, petro-chemicals, chemicals, water, power & metals in the Middle-East region; TAQA ardently formed joint ventures with various international companies and succeeded in gaining distributorship and Value-Added Reseller partnerships with international OEMs from the U.S.A., Canada, Europe, CIS and the Far East.

index_html.html.full_text: Welcome to Taqa Industrial and Petroleum Services Ltd   TAQA has a goal of modernizing and developing the major industrial sectors of energy, Oil & Gas, petrochemicals, mechanical & rotating equipment, utilities and other manufacturing in Iraq. TAQA is keen to work with leading global engineering, technology and services companies in order to successfully achieve this goal. To meet the growing needs of the local and regional market, we build and develop long-term and value added relationships with leading international industrial technology and engineering services partners. We are committed to our customers and partners with trust and quality as our utmost target. TAQA is a sister company of Saudi Arabian Development Company Ltd (SADC) which is operating in Saudi Arabia, the Gulf area and North Africa for over 30 years. SADC is specialized in serving the petroleum and energy sectors and has subsidiaries and investments in other companies such as Technip Saudi Arabia, Hamon D'Hondt Middle East Ltd, etc.

mission.html.title: TAQA Industrial and Petroleum Services - Our Mission
mission.html.full_text: Our Mission Taqa Industrial and Petroleum Services Ltd is a company with a mission to make a difference on Iraq's major industrial sector including petroleum, power, water, steel and other large manufacturing operations by modernizing it. TAQA aims to introduce the best of breed oil & gas, and industrial technology, services and know-how from our global partners. TAQA aims to establish strong relations with its partners that aim to lead to long term cooperation such as establishing joint ventures. TAQA has two main divisions; Mechanical & Instrumentation and Controls. Each division has its own sales force and technical staff to ensure that all customers’ needs are met and especially after-sales support. TAQA has a vision to be Iraq’s premiere industrial and petroleum technologies provider and to help modernize Iraq’s industrial sector to bring it to international standards.

Taqa Industrial and Petroleum Services Ltd is a company with a mission to make a difference on Iraq's major industrial sector including petroleum, power, water, steel and other large manufacturing operations by modernizing it. TAQA aims to introduce the best of breed oil & gas, and industrial technology, services and know-how from our global partners. TAQA aims to establish strong relations with its partners that aim to lead to long term cooperation such as establishing joint ventures.

TAQA has a vision to be Iraq’s premiere industrial and petroleum technologies provider and to help modernize Iraq’s industrial sector to bring it to international standards.

news001.html.title: TAQA Industrial and Petroleum Services - News
news001.html.full_text: News   TAQA exhibits at the 3 rd Basra Oil & Gas Conference and Exhibition TAQA participated in the 3 rd Basra Oil & Gas conference and exhibition from 6-9 December, 2012 at the Basra International Fair Ground. TAQA exhibited at stand B10 with its partners in Iraq including Cameron , Jiskoot , Cook Compression and Vega . The exhibit opened its gate to 18,000 visitors from over 35 countries in 2012, proving itself as an effective international exhibition. The event turned out to be the largest event in Iraq's oil and gas sector this year as it was in last year. TAQA exhibits at the 3rd Basra Oil & Gas Conference and Exhibition

TAQA participated in the 3rd Basra Oil & Gas conference and exhibition from 6-9 December, 2012 at the Basra International Fair Ground. TAQA exhibited at stand B10 with its partners in Iraq including Cameron, Jiskoot, Cook Compression and Vega. The exhibit opened its gate to 18,000 visitors from over 35 countries in 2012, proving itself as an effective international exhibition. The event turned out to be the largest event in Iraq's oil and gas sector this year as it was in last year.

TAQA will be participating in the coming 4th Exhibit to be held in Basra from 5-8 December 2013.

partners.html.full_text: Our Partners TAQA's main goal is to create long-lasting and mutually rewarding partnership with international leaders in their fields of Industrial Technologies. We are committed in maintaining and growing these relationships by working as a proactive partner, enabling and supporting the successful achievement of our mutual business goals as one. Constantly we will work with utmost dedication, by being sensitive to our customer needs and ensuring that we introduce what we believe are the best and up to date and proven products and services. Together, bearing this commitment in our hearts and minds, we will continue to grow and evolve from Distributors and Value-Added-Resellers (VAR) to successful Joint-Venture manufacturing and local services partners in Iraq and the rest of our market territory. We are always been keen to search for new solutions to introduce to our market. Please feel free to contact us if you feel we are a match for your products and services.
